title: Permission Flag Counter
brief: Our access-control service stores each account's permissions as a single integer mask, where every bit that is set grants one permission. The audit dashboard needs to show how many permissions each account holds.
Implement countGrantedFlags(n), where n is an account's permission mask, and return the number of bits set in its binary form.
